acceptanceCriteria: Test validity analyses Jest TypeScript test files on the same verdict axes as the existing JS provider, or the spec names each axis that cannot apply and why.
Fixture tests cover skipped, assertion-free and never-executed assertions in Jest.
body: From GitHub issue beamfall/corvint#1293 (opened 2026-10-20). Feature request; not yet specified. Test validity analyses Playwright and Ruby tests, but Jest (TypeScript) tests return an advisory 'not analysed' result. Repositories with Jest unit or integration suites therefore cannot get the same assertion-strength judgement (skipped tests, assertion-free tests, assertions that never execute) for those tests, and consumers must treat them as unreviewed. Ask: support Jest test files in test validity with the same verdict axes as the existing JS provider, or document which axes cannot apply. See beamfall/corvint#1293 for the full text.
title: Test validity: analyse TypeScript/Jest tests (issue #1293)
